patthana15.34:1.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.34:2.1: āsavasampayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.34:3.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na āsavasampayutto na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. āsavasāsavaduka kusalattike naāsavasāsavaduka nakusalattikaṃ
